# THE BERRY INTERPRETER (github.com/berry-lang/berry, MIT - see berry/LICENSE
# and berry/ORIGEM.txt). berry/ is the upstream copy; everything that belongs to M5tabOS
# lives in port/ (configuration, memory, module table) - except the few
# safety lines listed in ORIGEM.txt, marked "M5tabOS" in the sources.
#
# THE CONSTANT TABLES. Berry keeps fixed strings and objects in flash, and
# those tables are generated by the coc tool (Python) from the sources
# and berry_conf.h, in berry/generate/ (outside git). Runs at CMake
# configure time; if berry_conf.h changes, delete berry/generate/ and reconfigure.
set(berry_dir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/berry)

if(NOT CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
    idf_build_get_property(python PYTHON)
    if(NOT EXISTS ${berry_dir}/generate/be_const_strtab.h)
        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${berry_dir}/generate)
        execute_process(
            COMMAND ${python} ${berry_dir}/tools/coc/coc -o ${berry_dir}/generate
                    ${berry_dir}/src ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/port
                    -c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/port/berry_conf.h
            WORKING_DIRECTORY ${berry_dir}/tools/coc
            RESULT_VARIABLE coc_res)
        if(NOT coc_res EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Berry: coc did not generate the tables (berry/generate)")
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

file(GLOB berry_src ${berry_dir}/src/*.c)
idf_component_register(SRCS ${berry_src}
                            port/be_port.c port/be_modtab.c port/be_port_m5.c
                       INCLUDE_DIRS port ${berry_dir}/src
                       REQUIRES heap)

# Third-party code: its warnings are not ours to fix.
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE -w)
